contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.intro: Email is the most reliable way to reach me for questions about research, corrections, or collaboration.
contact.privacyNote: I keep personal details off this site intentionally. I do not publish my location beyond my state or phone number. Do not send private or sensitive information over email. Treat everything you send as ordinary unencrypted mail.
contact.corrections: If you think something here is wrong, tell me what and why, ideally with a source. Corrections are the most useful mail I get.
